info.name: compensation Scorecard Results API
info.description: The Compensation service enables applications to extend Workday's HCM Compensation features.

item.name: Updates the Score for the specified Scorecard Result

variable.description:
(Required) The Workday ID of the resource.

Accepts:
- **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string).
- **Reference ID**: Workday reference ID (Type=Value). Valid types: Compensation_Performance_Scorecard_Result_ID

(Required) The Workday ID of the subresource.

Accepts:
- **Workday ID**: Workday ID (32-character lowercase hexadecimal string).

request.description:
Sets the achievement value for the specified Score in the specified Scorecard Result.
Specify the required achievement value as a percentage (1-100%).

Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus

Scope: Advanced Compensation

response.name: Successful response. A successful response can return no matched data. Updating resource.

Invalid request. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)

You can’t update Scorecard Results used in a completed compensation review process.

request.description:
In the request body, specify these required fields:

* compensationScorecard - The Workday ID of a Compensation Scorecard. You can use a returned id from the GET /scorecards method.
* evaluationDate - The date when the Scorecard Result is evaluated. Use the yyyy-mm-dd format.

Secured By Domain: Set Up: Merit and Bonus

Scope: Advanced Compensation

response.name:
Invalid request. (https://community.workday.com/rest/error-messages)
